full_prompt_en: A surreal, photographically detailed image shows a young deer emerging from a dense, shadowed arrangement of flowers and moss. The composition is cropped at the animal's chest, so its head and short antlers occupy the center while vegetation presses in from every edge. A deep green-black background falls softly out of focus behind the subject. The deer faces toward the left in a three-quarter view, with one dark eye catching a small highlight and both ears raised. Its grey-brown coat has fine, natural fur texture, and a pale patch runs down the throat. Branching antlers rise into the upper part of the frame, threaded with small blossoms, seed heads, and tufts of greenery. A bright white daisy with a yellow center sits prominently between the ears, while tiny red and yellow flowers punctuate the antlers. Across the lower foreground, mossy mounds, dark leaves, and clustered blooms partly conceal the chest. A saturated red flower anchors the bottom center; smaller white and pink blossoms appear near the lower left. On the right, a soft white bloom and olive moss stand out against the murky backdrop, while a warm orange flower glows farther back on the left. The lighting is subdued and directional from the upper left, catching the eye, muzzle, petals, and raised textures while the surrounding foliage stays deep in shadow. Sharp detail at the face and nearby flowers gives way to blurred edges behind them. The close, dark framing and unexpectedly entwined flora make the scene feel both natural and dreamlike.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅具有摄影级细节的超现实图像：一只年轻的鹿从浓密、阴暗的花朵与苔藓丛中探出。画面在动物胸前裁切，头部和短鹿角占据中央，植物从四面边缘向内挤来。深绿近黑的背景在主体后方柔和失焦。鹿以朝左的四分之三侧面示人，一只深色眼睛接住小小的亮点，两耳竖起。灰棕色皮毛具有自然的细密纹理，喉部垂下一块浅色毛。分叉的鹿角伸入画面上方，细小花朵、种荚与绿色簇叶穿插其间。两耳之间一朵白色、黄心的雏菊格外醒目，极小的红花和黄花点缀鹿角。下方前景里，苔藓堆、深色叶片与成簇花朵部分掩住胸前。饱和的红花固定在底部中央，左下附近散着较小的白花和粉花。右侧一朵柔软的白花和橄榄绿苔藓在昏暗背景前显出，左边更远处则有一朵暖橙色花发亮。光线压低并从左上方定向照来，照出眼睛、口鼻、花瓣与凸起纹理，周围枝叶仍留在浓深的阴影里。面庞和近处花朵的锐利细节，向后方模糊的边缘过渡。贴近而深暗的取景，以及植物出人意料的交缠，使景象既自然又如梦。
style_prompt_en: Photographic realism is paired with dreamlike, densely layered arrangement. Rich charcoal-green shadow fills the frame, interrupted by restrained ivory, amber, rose, and vivid red accents. Fine surface detail is sharp in a compact central zone, while peripheral forms soften into shallow focus and nearly merge with the background. Directional light from above and one side catches small raised textures, leaving deep but color-rich recesses. Overlapping organic shapes press inward around the focal area, and a few luminous points prevent the dense composition from feeling flat. The result is intimate, tactile, and quietly uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影式写实质感与如梦般密集层叠的安排结合。浓郁的炭绿阴影填满画面，克制的象牙白、琥珀色、玫瑰色和鲜红色在其间跳出。细密表面在紧凑的中央区域清晰锐利，外围形体则因浅景深而软化，几乎融入背景。来自上方一侧的定向光照亮小片凸起纹理，使凹处保持深暗却仍富有色彩。重叠的有机形状向视觉焦点围拢，少数明亮点位让密实构图不至于扁平。整体效果亲密、可触，又带着安静的异样感。
theme_en: Deer emerging from a dark floral thicket
theme_zh: 从深色花丛中探出的鹿
name: Simen Johan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
